about.title: About Me
about.content: I build digital products—from idea to interaction. As a frontend developer, I combine product thinking, user experience, and modern web technologies to create intuitive and performant user experiences. I enjoy working at the intersection of product, design, and engineering, using AI as an integral part of my development workflow—from research and prototyping to debugging and refactoring. Product decisions, UX, and technical implementation remain my responsibility.

epilogue.title: Every product starts with an idea.
epilogue.content: The best ones come to life where concept, design, and engineering meet. I'm excited to bring the next ideas to life together.

contact.title: Let's build something together!
contact.description: Whether you have an idea or are looking for support with your next digital product, I'd love to hear from you.

project-1.title: Interactive Year Review — Web Experience
project-1.overview: Large-scale, consumer-facing web experience visualizing a personalized year in review, with a focus on interaction, motion, and intuitive UI behavior.
project-1.interactionMotion: Subtle motion cues, progressive reveals, and scroll-based storytelling were used to guide users through the experience in a calm and responsive way.
project-1.note: The content shown is based on anonymized screen recordings and a prototype to respect confidentiality.
project-1.contentMobile: This project was part of a large-scale, consumer-facing web experience designed to visualize a personalized year in review. My focus was on interaction, motion, and translating visual concepts into smooth, intuitive UI behavior.
project-1.altText: Screenshot of the Interactive Year Review web experience

project-2.title: Interactive Product Experience — Automotive Web Platform
project-2.overview: Interactive, motion-driven product experience for a high-end consumer website, focused on frontend prototyping, component development, and CMS integration.
myRole: Interactive prototypes for reusable UI components
Interactive components for product lines and configurations
Component and logic integration into a CMS
project-2.interactionMotion: Motion and scrolling guided users through complex product content in a fluid, immersive, and performance-aware way.
project-2.techStack: Twig.js | Vanilla JavaScript | GSAP | SCSS | Storybook | Pimcore CMS
project-2.note: The live website is publicly accessible. The work shown reflects my contribution to frontend prototyping, interaction logic, and CMS integration.
project-2.contentMobile: This project focused on building interactive, motion-driven product experiences for a high-end consumer website. My work centered on frontend prototyping, component development, and integrating interactive content into a CMS-driven environment.
project-2.altText: Screenshot of the Interactive Product Experience of the Automotive Web Platform

project-3.title: Fortune Slip — Interactive Web Experience
project-3.overview: Designed and developed an interactive web application that combines daily fortune slips with animated dialogue and playful user interactions. The goal was to create an engaging, performant experience that encourages users to return every day.
myRole: Designed the overall user experience and interaction flow
Built the user interface using React and TypeScript
Developed a reusable dialogue and fortune system
Created a fully responsive experience for desktop and mobile devices
project-3.interactionMotion: Animations enhance the emotional experience and guide users through the daily fortune journey—from drawing a fortune to revealing the result.
project-3.note: Independent passion project focused on UX, interaction design, and frontend architecture. Entirely designed and developed by me, from the initial concept to the final implementation.
project-3.contentMobile: This web application combines playful interactions with intuitive user flows. The focus was on creating a smooth user experience through reusable components, responsive design, and performant animations.
project-3.altText: Screenshot of the Fortune Slip web application
